newsitem.title: USA: CapStar gets $450 mln revolving credit line.
newsitem.headline: CapStar gets $450 mln revolving credit line.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co said Wednesday it has received a $450 million secured revolving line of credit and term loan facility.

The new facility was arranged by Lehman Brothers and increases its borrowing capacity by $225 million, it said. The facility will be used to repay about $218 million of debt, to fund future hotel acquisitions and for general corporate purposes, it added.
It said the facility is structured as a five-year, $350 million revolving loan and a seven year, $100 million term loan, it said.
Bankers Trust Co, BankBoston N.A. and Wells Fargo Bank N.A. were co-managers for the facility, it said.
CapStar, based in Washington, D.C., currently owns 34 hotels and manages 29 others.
